moments.title: Bake Off is BACK! Nigella joins the tent
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off returns for its 17th series tonight, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge, alongside hosts Alison Hammond and Noel Fielding.

angles.name: Launch Night Excitement
angles.copy: Grab your spatulas! The Great British Bake Off is back on Channel 4 tonight, and there's a new face in the tent. Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood as judge – let the baking begin! #GBBO

angles.name: Nigella's Debut
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson in the Bake Off tent! The iconic food writer makes her debut as a judge tonight on Channel 4. What bakes are you hoping to see her critique? #BakeOff

moments.title: Strictly Live Shows Kick Off
moments.blurb: After last Saturday's launch show revealed the celebrity pairings, the first live shows of Strictly Come Dancing Series 24 begin this Saturday, September 26, on BBC One.

angles.name: First Live Dance
angles.copy: Glitterball alert! The Strictly Come Dancing live shows kick off this Saturday, Sept 26! Who are you backing to dazzle on the dance floor in week one? #Strictly

angles.name: New Hosts & Judges
angles.copy: New era, new moves! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe host the first live Strictly this Saturday. Get ready for the judges' verdicts!
